newsitem.title: UK: SHELL, BP UP AFTER ADRS ADVANCE.
newsitem.headline: SHELL, BP UP AFTER ADRS ADVANCE.

text.p: Shares in Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc and British Petroleum were indicated higher on Tuesday, tracking a strong performance in their ADRs overnight, dealers said.
Shell shares were marked up 11p to 451-1/2 in pre-market trading at 0715 GMT, while BP shares were up 18p to 907-1/2.
In New York, Shell ADRs jumped $2-3/16 to $87-1/8. BP ADRs added $10/16 to $42-9/16.
"All the oils were good overnight," a market maker said.
American oil companies were lifted after a Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette analyst said he expected Mobil Corp and Amoco Corp to announce a 50-50 downstream venture nN1119325.
Shares in Mobil climbed $3-9/16 to $76-7/16, while Amoco shares rose $2-1/16 to $95-13/16.
Elsewhere, shares in Chevron Corp rose $2-7/16 to $80-1/8, and shares in Texaco Inc advanced $2-1/8 to $115.
